CustomField.description: Salesforce formula returning true or false, evaluated by DisclaimerLogicalRules on each selected product. Every field is prefixed with its object (Product__c.LegalForm__c); lookups can be followed (Product__c.Parent__r.Name). Condition Scope says whether at least one or all selected products must pass. Never passes when no product is selected. Empty = no condition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula returning true or false. Prefix every field with its object: ISPICKVAL(Product__c.LegalForm__c, "SICAV"). Picklists: ISPICKVAL() or TEXT(). Empty = no condition.
CustomField.label: Condition
